h1: About Kolkata Trips – Private Tours & Bespoke Experiences in Kolkata
textContent: About Kolkata Trips – Private Tours & Bespoke Experiences in Kolkata Book Tour Discover Kolkata Through Bespoke Experiences Some cities are visited. Kolkata is experienced. Known as the City of Joy, Kolkata captivates visitors with its magnificent colonial architecture, vibrant markets, spiritual landmarks, artistic heritage, world-famous cuisine, and warm hospitality. Every street tells a story, every neighbourhood preserves history, and every journey reveals another hidden gem. At Kolkata Trips, we believe every traveller deserves more than a standard sightseeing itinerary. We create Bespoke Experiences that allow you to truly Discover Kolkata through its people, culture, traditions, and timeless heritage. Whether you are visiting for a few hours or several days, we design journeys that are personal, immersive, and unforgettable. Who We Are Kolkata Trips is a private tour operator based in Kolkata, India, specializing in personalized sightseeing tours and cultural journeys throughout Kolkata and West Bengal. With more than a decade of experience, we have welcomed thousands of travellers from around the world who want to experience the city beyond the usual tourist route. Our experienced team combines historical knowledge, local insights, and genuine hospitality to deliver carefully curated Bespoke Tours that suit every traveller’s interests, pace, and schedule. Whether you’re a first-time visitor, a returning traveller, a family, a solo explorer, or a small private group, our goal is simple—to help you experience Kolkata like a local while enjoying the comfort and flexibility of a private guided tour. Our Mission Our mission is to transform ordinary sightseeing into meaningful travel experiences. Instead of rushing from one landmark to another, we create thoughtfully designed itineraries that allow you to appreciate Kolkata’s history, architecture, spirituality, cuisine, literature, art, and everyday life. Every journey is designed to be informative, comfortable, flexible, and memorable. Our Most Popular Tours Whether you are looking for a few hours of exploration, a multi-day cultural journey, or an excursion beyond the city, Kolkata Trips offers some of the best Kolkata tours designed for curious travellers seeking authentic and personalized experiences. Our carefully curated private tours include: Full Day Kolkata City Tour – Discover Kolkata’s iconic landmarks, colonial architecture, bustling markets, spiritual sites, and hidden neighbourhoods in one comprehensive day. Customised Kolkata City Tour – Enjoy a fully personalized itinerary designed around your interests, whether it’s history, photography, street food, architecture, shopping, or local culture. Experience Kolkata in 2 Days – Private Guided Tour – Immerse yourself in the city’s rich heritage over two days, exploring famous landmarks alongside lesser-known cultural treasures at a relaxed pace. Kolkata Heritage Tour – Walk through centuries of history as you explore colonial-era buildings, historic neighbourhoods, magnificent churches, temples, and heritage landmarks. Private Guided Tour of Little Europe in Bengal – Step back in time on an unforgettable journey through Bengal’s remarkable European heritage. Explore the historic settlements of Bandel (Portuguese), Chinsurah (Dutch), Chandannagar (French), Serampore (Danish), where magnificent churches, colonial mansions, museums, riverside promenades, and centuries-old landmarks tell the fascinating story of European influence in eastern India. This immersive private guided tour offers a unique blend of history, architecture, culture, and local insights, making it one of the most distinctive heritage experiences in West Bengal. Day Trip to Bishnupur – Terracotta Temples & Silk Weavers – Journey to the UNESCO Tentative List heritage town of Bishnupur to admire its magnificent 17th-century terracotta temples and witness the exquisite craftsmanship of traditional Baluchari silk weavers. Private Day Trips from Kolkata – Explore some of West Bengal’s most captivating destinations, including Santiniketan, Mayapur, Sundarbans, Murshidabad, Gangasagar, and other culturally significant locations. Half Day Kolkata City Tour – Ideal for business travellers, cruise passengers, and visitors with limited time who want to experience the highlights of the City of Joy. Whether you’re searching for a Kolkata city tour, half-day Kolkata tour, Kolkata sightseeing tour, private Kolkata tour, Kolkata guided tour, custom Kolkata tour, or comprehensive Kolkata tour packages, Kolkata Trips offers thoughtfully designed experiences that combine local expertise, premium service, flexibility, and authentic cultural immersion. Posted on Tripadvisor Sophia 27 April 2026 Verified Perfect Heritage Escape – Best Bishnupur Day Trip from Kolkata We recently booked a Kolkata to Bishnupur one day tour package with Kolkata Trips, and it was one of the most rewarding cultural experiences we have had in West Bengal. If you are searching for a well-organized one day trip near Kolkata, this tour is an excellent choice. The day started with an early morning pickup from Kolkata in a clean and comfortable air-conditioned car. The drive was smooth, and our guide shared interesting stories about Bengal’s history during the journey. For anyone planning a Kolkata to Bishnupur one day tour, this private arrangement makes the trip stress-free and enjoyable. The Bishnupur sightseeing itinerary was thoughtfully planned, covering all the major attractions without feeling rushed. We visited the famous Bishnupur Terracotta Temples, which are truly masterpieces of architecture and craftsmanship. Seeing the historic Rasmancha in person was unforgettable. Its unique structure and royal history make it one of the top places to visit in Bishnupur. We also explored the beautiful Shyam Rai Temple, known for its intricate terracotta panels, followed by the iconic Jorbangla Temple, a must-see for lovers of heritage architecture. The peaceful Madan Mohan Temple and sacred Mrinmoyee Temple added a spiritual touch to the journey. Every monument had its own story, and the guide explained everything clearly and passionately. What we appreciated most was how smoothly the day was managed. Despite covering so many important sites, the pace was comfortable, with enough time for photography, exploration, and local snacks. It felt like a true Bishnupur day trip designed for travelers who want quality experiences, not just rushed sightseeing. If you are interested in history, culture, and architecture, this is one of the finest Heritage tours in West Bengal. Bishnupur is a hidden gem, and Kolkata Trips did a wonderful job showcasing its beauty and significance. Highly recommended for anyone looking for memorable Bishnupur sightseeing from Kolkata with professional service and genuine local hospitality. Posted on Tripadvisor Inspire59089999388 15 April 2026 Verified A Truly Enriching Journey to the Hidden Gems of Bishnupur We recently had the pleasure of experiencing the Hidden Treasures of Bishnupur – Private Day Tour from Kolkata with Kolkata Trips, and it turned out to be one of the most memorable cultural excursions I’ve taken in West Bengal. The journey begins early in the morning with a comfortable pick-up from Kolkata. Although the drive to Bishnupur takes around 3.5 to 4 hours each way, the scenic countryside—lush green paddy fields, rustic villages, and peaceful rural landscapes—makes the journey quite enjoyable and refreshing. What truly sets this tour apart is the depth of cultural immersion. Bishnupur is a treasure trove of heritage, famous for its stunning terracotta temples built during the Malla dynasty. Exploring iconic sites like Ras Mancha, Shyam Rai Temple, Jor Bangla Temple, and Madanmohan Temple was an absolute delight. The intricate terracotta carvings depicting mythological stories are simply breathtaking and offer a fascinating glimpse into Bengal’s rich artistic legacy. A special mention must go to the guide, whose knowledge and storytelling brought each monument to life. The historical context, architectural details, and cultural anecdotes added immense value to the experience. The tour is well-paced, allowing ample time at each site without feeling rushed, and the private setup ensures a very personalized and flexible experience. Another highlight was the opportunity to witness local craftsmanship, especially the famous Baluchari silk weaving. It added a unique dimension to the tour, connecting history with living traditions. Yes, it is a long day (approximately 12 hours), but every moment feels worthwhile. The comfort of an air-conditioned vehicle, seamless planning, and attentive service make the experience smooth and enjoyable throughout. Overall, this tour is perfect for anyone interested in history, architecture, and authentic cultural experiences. If you’re looking to explore beyond Kolkata and discover a lesser-known yet incredibly rich heritage destination, Bishnupur is a must-visit—and Kolkata Trips does a fantastic job curating this journey.
